name: 型を示すデータベース列見出し
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Component LH09-0044: Japanese database column-type header row only.
Image1 original screen and image2 original crop are PRIMARY for icon anatomy, stroke/optical weight, proportions, exact six-column layout, spacing and fine details. Image3 is SECONDARY Japanese copy/layout guide; replace its text/symbol substitutes with original proper glyphs.
One wide compact row on pure white, original faint horizontal baseline, six cells with these labels/icons: underlined Aa text-type glyph then「作業名」; segmented radial status glyph then「状態」; original filled two-person silhouette then「担当者」; original outline calendar glyph then「期日」; diagonal up-right relation arrow then「期間」; same arrow then「案件」. Icon sizes and optical weights match original, do not invent circle, club, square substitutes. Meiryo Regular14/24, zero tracking, no bold; quiet secondary gray text and consistent slate #526173 icons. Keep original column-width proportions, all six columns aligned horizontally. Header only, no data rows, menu, button, title, additional card, colored panel or decorative elements. No accent because these are neutral property-type descriptors. Pure-white outer canvas. Sharp UI export, preserve readable compact hierarchy.
reviewNotes: All six Japanese headers and Aa/radial-status/people/calendar/relation-arrow types checked against original; mock substitutions corrected. Neutral slate, white canvas, regular labels. Exact strokes/font and output scale unproved.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
